shared_elements: row of short repeated vertical strokes along a horizontal line (fringe/comb-like motif)
upcurving hook-like terminals at the ends of a horizontal element
justification: The only real correspondence is formal and generic: both surfaces stack horizontal bands, and both include a long horizontal line topped by a row of short repeated vertical strokes with upturned hooked ends (a hatched/fringed band in A, a manned boat with curved prows in B). Otherwise the subject matter is entirely different: A depicts identifiable creatures in profile relief (birds, quadrupeds, snake, a small anthropomorph) interacting on a pillar, while B depicts two vessel-like linear forms with crew strokes and isolated dots, with no animals or figures at all.
